**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline).**

- **Where it lives:** the renewal mechanic is not in § 5 as the planner hinted; it sits in Section 13 (Term of Agreement) at p0078, with the pricing controls in § 5/§ 6 (p0045, p0047).
- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods after a 1-year initial term — 12 months, so no automatic multi-year renewal and no walk-away exposure.
- **Non-renewal window:** **30 days** prior to the end of the then-current year, exercisable by Client — inside the fallback 60-day ceiling and meeting the preferred 30-day opt-out.
- **Price increases:** renewal carries no unilateral uplift right. Fees are fixed by Exhibits A/B, § 6 freezes Hosting Services costs for year one and adds an MFN ("rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party"), and § 16 requires any amendment to be signed by the party to be charged — so the conditional price-cap element is never triggered.
- **Noted, not flagged:** there is no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal (preferred-only sub-element). Per the playbook this is noted in the rationale rather than redlined, since the bargain already exceeds the fallback.
